admin.sessions.title: Recordings from Fly by Sound
admin.sessions.help: Flights, and the pilot's voice, that pilots chose to send. Each one is stored on the server first, then sent to you by Telegram and by e-mail with retries. Download it, send a channel again, or delete it when a pilot or a parent asks.
admin.sessions.retention: A recording is kept for at most {days} days after it arrived; one that is still waiting for a channel is never removed by age.
admin.sessions.summary: {stored} stored, {delivered} delivered, {waiting} waiting, {failed} with a channel that gave up. {size} in all.
admin.sessions.config.unset: {channel}: NOT set up, so recordings wait on the server until it is.
admin.sessions.search: Search by id, lesson or language
admin.sessions.deleted: Deleted. The audit trail keeps only that it was deleted on request.
admin.sessions.reason.unknown: the server has no such recording
admin.sessions.reason.not-stored: that recording is not stored yet
admin.sessions.resend.telegram.full: Send this recording by Telegram again
admin.sessions.resend.email.full: Send this recording by e-mail again
admin.sessions.resend.sure.full: It already arrived by this channel. Press again to send it again.
admin.sessions.delete.sure.full: Press again to delete this recording for good.
